lines.text: The believers shared everything they owned, and those who owned lands or houses sold them and laid the money at the apostles' feet.
Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas, sold a field and laid the money at the apostles' feet.
Ananias and his wife Sapphira sold property, and Ananias kept back some money, so Peter said he had lied to the Holy Spirit.
When Ananias heard Peter's words, he fell down and died, and the old men carried him out and buried him.
About three days later Sapphira answered Peter falsely, fell down and died, and the young men buried her beside her husband.
